login_url.description:
LoginURL is where the sign-in button sends the browser, for a provider
whose flow is a redirect. Empty for cognito, whose sign-in is a form this
server posts to.

password_login.description:
PasswordLogin and Signup are false for OIDC: the issuer owns its users, so
there is no password form and no signup page to route to.

provider.description:
Provider is "cognito", "oidc", or "none" (dev auth, every request sharing
one account).

social_providers.description:
SocialProviders are the Cognito-brokered buttons. Empty under OIDC, where
federation is the issuer's configuration and invisible from here.

plan_id.description:
PlanID is one of "starter" | "growth" | "scale". Free and
enterprise are not Checkout-eligible -- the handler 400s.

content_hash.description:
ContentHash is the hex-encoded SHA-256 of the file bytes, computed by
the client before requesting the presigned URL. It is used as the S3
sub-directory so that (a) the same filename with different content gets
a unique path, and (b) re-uploading identical bytes is idempotent.

size.description:
Size is the client's *declared* size — only a UX-nicety early
rejection. The actual cap signed into the policy (see RequestUploadURL's
signedCap) is derived entirely from server-side state, so a lied-about
Size can't get more past S3 than an honest one could.

folders.description:
Folders replaces the theme's own folder list. The Blank theme exists for
exactly this: it ships no meaningful layout, so the caller names the
first folder instead. Omitted, the theme's folders are used.

folder_id.description:
FolderID files the new datapack into a project folder. Required once the
Projects feature is on and the caller has at least one project — see
ProjectService.ValidateNewDatapackFolder. Ignored when the feature is
off, so the field is additive for existing clients.

BearerAuth.description: JWT access token from /auth/login. Format: Bearer {token}
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
